In [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> a '''prototype assault walker''' was stolen by the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], from a [[Factory/Legends|factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], and deployed during the [[Dantooine Incursion]].
